lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: This is Dorothy from Eden.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Are these messages coming through?
Loud and clear.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Good.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Starting today, I am to provide you with assistance, Your Grace.
What, may I ask, is the reason for this kind offer?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: There is no special reason.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: It is merely something I have decided to do, nothing more.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Although I realize you and I

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: will not be able to understand each other fully,

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: there is much overlap in our ideology.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: It is for that reason that I've decided to assist you.
Well, thanks, I guess.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: You mustn't thank me so soon.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: It is far too early for that.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: We have only just begun.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: I should also mention that I expect certain things of you as well.
Why is that?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: It takes a remarkable individual to garner such a reputation in the Ark,

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: and still manage to find their way to Eden in one piece.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: It's not often that I take such an interest in other people.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: I hope that interest is not misplaced.
I'll try and make it worth your while.
You won't be disappointed.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Very well.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: It's nice to see you're willing to give it your best shot,

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: but results are the only thing that matters.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: I hope you can have some more confidence in your abilities going forward.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: I'm relieved to see that you're confident.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: For now at least, it appears I have chosen wisely.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: I'm looking forward to working with you.
Likewise.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: I'll be in touch

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: when one of us requires assistance from the other.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Have a nice day.
